proposal.reason: Primary change is communicator configuration control: new config fields are validated/defaulted, overridden from env, stored on comm, and synchronized across ranks during init. enqueue is additionally required because graphUsageMode now changes strong-stream graph capture/mixing acquire/release behavior (strongstream + enqueue/channel call paths). device-topology is additionally required because P2P channel-per-peer computation in topo path logic now uses nChannelsPerNetPeer/maxP2pPeers to alter channel allocation behavior.
